title: Availability & DDoS Reasoning
reward: Learn availability abuse as impact plus behavior, not traffic volume alone.
knowledge: Separate request flood, connection pressure, upstream exhaustion and legitimate flash crowd.
Measure deviation together with latency, errors, saturation and source/route distribution.
Distributed volume is not automatically coordinated hostility.
Application overload can amplify modest traffic; infrastructure capacity is part of causality.
DDoS remains a hypothesis until independent availability evidence supports it.
challenge: Contrast flash crowd and DDoS hypotheses using conflicting evidence.
Explain why high request count alone cannot pass.
next_requires: Tie availability claims to measured effect and alternatives.
